item.text: The lookup returns `0` for both an empty store and a valid `ps-0` session. The bookmark hook then passes that value to `resumeSession`. I’ll return `null` when no valid ID is found and have the hook resume only when it has an ID.

The utility now recognizes numeric session keys, including `ps-0`, and returns `null` when none are usable. I’ve added coverage for invalid keys, parsing errors, storage preservation, and password restoration in the bookmark hook; the focused tests are running now.

item.text:
Updated Proton Drive’s persisted session lookup to return `number | null`, accept only numeric `ps-` keys, preserve the valid ID `0`, and leave localStorage untouched. The public bookmark hook now resumes a session only when an ID exists, restoring its saved key password before listing bookmarks.

The two relevant Jest suites passed: 17 tests total. `git diff --check` also passed.
